original.target_description: Taipale et al. (2021), published article, Table 2 and results p. 887 (PDF p. 5): cumulative antipsychotic exposure and breast cancer. The supplied four rows have identical descriptions and locators, without identifying exposure class, duration, adjusted/unadjusted estimate or subtype.

replication.target_description: Swedish nationwide matched conditional logistic regression of breast cancer and antipsychotic exposure; identical supplied locators do not distinguish among multiple exposure/model/subgroup tests.

reported_success.location: Discussion, first paragraph (comparison with the Finnish nationwide study)
reported_success.quote: These findings are consistent with those of a similar nested case–control study previously conducted in Finland

notes:
All four assigned records supply identical neutral descriptions and p. 5 locators, without exposure duration/category, adjusted versus unadjusted model, cancer subtype, or population subgroup identifiers. The replication full text is available and its identity verified against Europe PMC DOI/title metadata (PMC11548924). Multiple distinct matching candidate tests are printed; assigning them among IDs by order would be unsupported. Replication Table 2, adjusted OR column, prints prolactin-increasing 1–<5 years: 1.20 (1.03–1.41), ≥5 years: 1.47 (1.26–1.71); prolactin-sparing 1–<5 years: 1.17 (0.98–1.40), ≥5 years: 0.99 (0.78–1.26). These are candidate observations only, not selected effects. Table 2 also prints unadjusted models; Table 3 prints cumulative-dose models and Table 5 subgroup models. No exact p values are supplied for the Table 2 candidate ORs; no p values derived from confidence intervals. Results/Table 1 identify 1642 breast-cancer cases and 8173 matched controls; a specific target model/sample cannot be selected. Original full primary source unavailable after DOI landing redirect, Unpaywall (closed; no OA locations), OpenAlex (closed; no repository full text), Europe PMC (no full text), Helsinki repository metadata only, and ScienceDirect 403. Original values quoted in the replication were not substituted for original primary evidence. Narrative success is study-level, independently stated in the replication Discussion; it does not resolve which effect each audit ID targets.
Source follow-up: Primary paper available and target page rendered. Four indistinguishable target locators cannot be assigned to individual OR tests without guessing. Table 2 includes 1–4-year and ≥5-year exposure, prolactin-increasing and prolactin-sparing, adjusted and unadjusted ORs; nearby text also reports DDD and cancer-subtype analyses. No ordering inferred. Source version: Published article copy from private Google Drive archive; DOI is not printed in the artifact front matter. Independent Crossref record matches exact requested title and author surname(s), year/issue and page range 883-891. PDF has9pages, complete main paper with methods/results and end references; model-reviewed first-page and final-substantive-page excerpts. First-page authors=Taipale,Solmi,Lähteenvuo,Tanskanen,Correll,Tiihonen; title coverage=1.0. No shipped audit-value comparison.
